comparison.objective: Remove a USB receiver from a mouse slot and insert it into a laptop.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part extraction, reorientation, and connector insertion; it shares precision grasping but not hammer-mediated notch fracture or loose-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Receiver transfers between matching slots; candidate requires four contact-loaded fractures, four recovered tangs, and unchanged retained inserts.
comparison.reason: Shared small-part alignment is generic; connector transfer does not test controlled fracture and fragment containment.
